Vitou is a traditional card game from Nice, France (Niçois/Provençal heritage). It is also played in Piedmont, the Provence Alps, and under various guises in Lombardy, Friuli, and Suisse Romande. It is closely related to the Catalan game Truc but was adapted to the French 32-card Belote deck; the 10s and 9s substitute for the missing low cards, giving the game its distinctive ranking (10, 9, Ace high). The rules documented for this game derive from information provided by Nicolas Morlino.
3 cards each, clockwise. First dealer: lowest card from draw.

items.text: Standard (4 players): Four players in two partnerships; 3 cards each; best two of three tricks per round; first team to 21 points wins. Can also be played with 2 players.
